value.rationale: The problem is motivated by the 2026 discovery of nonperiodic maximizing measures on specification beta-shifts. The exact low-temperature polynomial rates of three physical/statistical quantities for the simplest locally constant digit observable are unknown from the source and not implied by its qualitative optimization/stability statements. The result combines a natural countable renewal model with bounded-type rotation arithmetic, and classifies the unique ground state in the same theorem, yielding reproducible nontrivial structural dynamical information.
